title: Spaceship Fuel Pod Collection & Meteor Dodge
prompt:
Create a single HTML file with an interactive 3D space game using Three.js and GLTFLoader (from CDN: https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/three@0.163.0/build/three.module.js and https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/three@0.163.0/examples/jsm/loaders/GLTFLoader.js).

## Scene Setup
- Black background with a starfield (200+ small white sphere particles scattered in a large box around the play area).
- Perspective camera at z=30 looking toward origin, FOV 60.
- Ambient light (intensity 0.4) + directional light from (5,10,7) intensity 1.0.
- The play area is bounded: X in [-20, 20], Y in [-12, 12]. Objects wrap or are clamped to these bounds.

## 3D Models
- Load 'ClearCoatCarPaint.glb' as the SPACESHIP. Scale it to roughly 1.5 units. Place it at (0, 0, 0). This is the player-controlled ship.
- Load 'BoomBox.glb' as the template for FUEL PODS. Scale each instance to about 0.4 units. Fuel pods glow with a green emissive tint (traverse the model and set material.emissive to green, intensity 0.5).
- For METEORS, create procedural geometry: THREE.DodecahedronGeometry with radius 0.6-1.2 (random), brown/grey MeshStandardMaterial with roughness 0.9. Meteors rotate slowly on random axes.

## Game Mechanics
- The spaceship moves via WASD or Arrow keys. W/ArrowUp = move up, S/ArrowDown = move down, A/ArrowLeft = move left, D/ArrowRight = move right. Movement speed: 12 units/sec. The ship is clamped to the play area bounds.
- Fuel pods spawn every 2 seconds at x=25 (off-screen right) with random Y in [-10, 10], and drift left at speed 5 units/sec. Max 5 fuel pods on screen.
- Meteors spawn every 1.5 seconds at x=25 with random Y in [-10, 10], drift left at speed 7 units/sec. Max 8 meteors on screen. Each meteor has a random rotation speed.
- Collision detection: use distance-based checks. Ship-to-fuel-pod collision radius = 2.0 units. Ship-to-meteor collision radius = 2.0 units.
- Collecting a fuel pod: increment score by 10, increment fuelCollected counter, remove the pod from scene.
- Hitting a meteor: decrement lives by 1, set ship to 'invulnerable' for 2 seconds (ship blinks by toggling visibility every 100ms), remove the meteor.
- Game starts in 'ready' state. Press SPACE to start. Game runs until lives reach 0, then state becomes 'gameover'.
- Press R to restart the game (reset score, lives, fuelCollected, remove all pods and meteors, reset ship position).
- Starting lives = 3, starting score = 0.

## HUD / DOM Elements
- A HUD overlay div (id='hud') at top of screen showing: Score (span id='scoreDisplay'), Lives (span id='livesDisplay'), Fuel Collected (span id='fuelDisplay').
- A centered message div (id='messageDisplay'): shows 'Press SPACE to Start' initially, 'GAME OVER - Press R to Restart' when gameover, hidden during gameplay.
- A pause button (id='pauseBtn') that toggles pause state. When paused, all movement stops and messageDisplay shows 'PAUSED'.

## State Management
Expose window.__3D_STATE__ updated every frame with:
- shipX, shipY: spaceship position (numbers)
- score: current score (number)
- lives: current lives (number)
- fuelCollected: total fuel pods collected (number)
- gameState: 'ready' | 'playing' | 'paused' | 'gameover' (string)
- activeFuelPods: count of fuel pods currently in scene (number)
- activeMeteors: count of meteors currently in scene (number)
- isInvulnerable: boolean, true if ship is in invulnerability frames
- shipVisible: boolean, current visibility of ship mesh
- elapsedTime: seconds since game started playing (number, 0 when not playing)
- modelsLoaded: boolean, true once both GLB models finish loading
- meteorSpeedX: the horizontal drift speed of meteors (should be ~7)
- fuelPodSpeedX: the horizontal drift speed of fuel pods (should be ~5)
- spawnedMeteorsTotal: cumulative count of all meteors ever spawned this round
- spawnedFuelPodsTotal: cumulative count of all fuel pods ever spawned this round
physics_constraints: Ship must stay clamped within play area [-20,20] x [-12,12]. Objects drifting past x=-25 are removed. Collision is distance-based (radius 2.0). Invulnerability lasts exactly 2 seconds. Score only increases by 10 per fuel pod. Lives only decrease by 1 per meteor hit. No NaN in any position or score values.
